title: Treasury International Capital (TIC) monthly release (January 2027 data) + the quarterly cut — the March triple, 4:00 p.m. ET
source: EST: home.treasury.gov/data/treasury-international-capital-tic-system/release-dates-of-tic-data, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (plain curl, HTTP 200, 111,181 bytes) by the tic-monthly-2027-02-18 initial-research adjacency sweep — its 2027 table's March row reads '18' in the Monthly column AND '18' in the Quarterly (nonfinancial firms, derivatives, portfolio claims and liabilities) column, with '31' in the separate gross-external-debt column, under the page header 'All data releases occur at 4 p.m. Washington, D.C. time'. Reference month January 2027 by the page's own 1.5-month lag rule. Corroborated mechanically: February 2027 having no bearing on it, the 11th business day of March 2027 (no 5 U.S.C. 6103 holiday falls in the month) is 2027-03-15, putting the published date at offset +3 business days — inside the page's own '11th business day plus 0 to 3 days' rule but AT ITS EDGE, which is stated rather than smoothed. The same holiday-aware convention lands in-window on 22 of the 24 published 2026-27 dates and hits 9 exactly, recomputed from scratch by this session. Filed estimate per this lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep: the proposer may not confirm what it found, only the event's own session may. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: DISCOVERED during the tic-monthly-2027-02-18 initial research (2026-09-09) from that event's own primary fetch of Treasury's release-dates page. Proposed as THE NEXT UNCLAIMED SLOT — 2027-02-18 is now canonical, 2027-02-26 is already proposed by the January sibling, and 2027-03-18 is the first monthly date nobody holds. IT ALSO HAS A SPECIFIC JOB, and it is the live alternative this session refused to assert. tic-monthly-2027-01-19 measured that Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct revision editions restate an overlapping monthly cell by $5.01bn vs $1.67bn ordinary (t=+3.93) — but only after excluding February/March vintages post-hoc; left in, the test is a flat null (p=0.78). This session found the STATED grounds for that exclusion do not survive the primary: Treasury's note (d) dates the annual-survey-feeds-March convention to BEFORE SEPTEMBER 2011, and the February monthly release precedes the preliminary survey by eight days rather than containing it. What is left is that the sibling's three Feb/Mar outliers are ONE February (2024-02, which its own text disqualifies as sitting across footnote 9's series break) and TWO MARCHES — and March, unlike February, is a TRIPLE release: monthly plus the quarterly cut plus gross external debt. That is a structural difference between the two months this calendar can actually observe, and 2027-03-18 is where it gets observed. Read together, 2027-02-18 and 2027-03-18 separate 'February is a distinct mechanism' from 'the effect was always March's triple-release structure'; neither alone can. Impact LOW and symbols empty on the standing grounds (16:00 ET is after the equity cash close, the data is six weeks stale, no house playbook is macro-keyed). Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
